_key.description: Complex accession and Ensembl protein ID joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Document handle of the source node, in collection/key form.

_to.description: Document handle of the target node, in collection/key form.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction.

stoichiometry.description: Number of copies of this protein in the complex. 0 means the stoichiometry is unknown.

chain_id.description: UniProt chain identifier when the participant is a specific processed chain rather than the full protein. Null otherwise.

isoform_id.description: UniProt isoform number when the participant is a specific isoform. Null otherwise.

number_of_paralogs.description: Count of interchangeable paralogs when this participant is a molecule set. Null for a single protein.

paralogs.description: UniProt accessions of the interchangeable paralogs when this participant is a molecule set. Null for a single protein.

linked_features.description: Binding regions between this protein and other participants of the complex, taken from the Complex Portal API: each entry names a participant and the residue ranges involved.

source.description: The dataset or consortium this record was loaded from.

source_url.description: Link to the specific upstream record or file this data was loaded from.

class.description: Evidence tier for the underlying data, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

method.description: Model or pipeline that produced this record, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this record was read from.

accessible_via.return: stoichiometry, chain_id, isoform_id, number_of_paralogs, linked_features, class, method, label, files_filesets, source, source_url
